Bachelor of Science

Semiconductor Engineering

For the Bachelor of Science degree in Semiconductor Engineering a minimum of 127 credit hours (Semiconductor Device Engineering emphasis area) or 128 credit hours (Semiconductor Process Engineering emphasis area) is required. A cumulative grade point average of at least 2.0 is required for all courses applied toward the degree, as well as for all required courses in the major field of study, defined as SEMI ENG, ELEC ENG, COMP ENG, and/or CHEM ENG.
